messages:
mira: Quick async standup — kernel/batching/KV perf check

mira: What I did: landed the microbatch allocator change (PR #842), added a short-circuit for single-token requests to skip batch slot allocation, and ran a few 1k-request perf passes against canary.

mira: Blockers: seeing higher-than-expected tail latency for tiny requests when KV cache hit-rate < 20%. Not yet sure if it's scheduler contention or lock churn in the KVCache map.

mira: Today: instrumenting per-shard lock contention metrics and trying a quick switch to striped locks; will also add a small experiment with `batch_size_hint=1` default for short requests.

alex: Nice work. For the KV hit-rate issue, did you repro locally with the same request distribution?

mira: repro'd with a local loadgen script that mirrors the canary traces. When I artificially lower hot prefixes it spikes. Attaching the perf snippet I ran: 

```
# simplified run
./loadgen --model rdx-small --qps 200 --seq 32 --mix tiny:70,small:20,med:10 
# observed p99 tail: 480ms -> 720ms when KV hit <20%
```

sam: Re: striped locks — +1. We use shard_count=16 in other places; maybe try 64 for KVCache since keys are cheap. Also pinging @jen about kernel prefetch changes — any regressions from the new prefetch window calc?

jen: I ran the prefetch sweep against canary yesterday. No correctness regressions, but there was a ~4% throughput drop on long-seq workloads when prefetch window expanded. That might interact with the microbatch allocator.

mira: good catch. If prefetch pulls more KV pages earlier, it could increase memory pressure and cause more GC/evictions, reducing hit-rate. I'll add memstats to the perf passes.

alex: For the quick experiment, I can patch CI job to run the microbatch perf harness on the canary infra (quiet window tonight). Want me to queue it?

mira: yes please, enqueue the canary run and include `KV_SHARD=64` env and `BATCH_HINT=1` variables. Also add the memstats flag `--collect-mem` to the harness.

ci-bot: build queued: perf-canary-run-3123456789 (env: KV_SHARD=64, BATCH_HINT=1, collect-mem=true). ETA ~20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: Quick code review ping: mira — left one comment on PR #842 about moving the allocator config to a runtime flag instead of hardcoded const. Small change but helps for the experiments.

mira: saw it, will push a follow-up in the next 30m. If the canary run shows improvement, I'll open a rollout plan doc for a limited canary on dedicated pools.

jen: also, if we stabilize this, let's schedule a short sync with infra to pre-warm KV caches on rollback paths. Last time rollback coldstarts caused a big spike.

mira: noted. thanks all. will post results when CI finishes. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — ping here when results are in, and if p99 drops we can ship the allocator change to canary small pool tomorrow.

mira: will do.
